original_question: Mark yɛ nsɛmni ho kyerɛwfoɔ. Ɔkyerɛ nsɛmfua dodoɔ baako wɔ nnawɔtwe biara ma dea ɔtintim nnwoma mmienu a deɛ ɛda nso wɔn mu biara tua no ka soronko wɔ asɛmfua biara ho. Ɔdawurubɔfo B tua Mark ka no mmɔho mmienu a dawurubɔfo A tuaɛ. Mark siesie nsɛmfua bɛyɛ sɛ 1,000 wɔ nnawɔtwe biara mu, na Ɔkyerɛwfo A tua no 5 cent wɔ asɛm biara ho. Mark nya sika ahe wɔ nnawɔtwe biara, wɔ cent mu?
